about: The Alma Redemptoris Mater is the final Marian antiphon for the season from Advent through the Purification of the Blessed Virgin Mary. The faithful ask Mary, Mother of the Redeemer, to help the falling people and have mercy on sinners.

s01.translation: Gracious Mother of the Redeemer, you who remain heaven's open gate,

translation_citations.title: Francis X. Lasance, The Catholic Girl's Guide (1906)

s02.translation: and the star of the sea, come to the aid of the falling,

translation_citations.title: Francis X. Lasance, The Catholic Girl's Guide (1906)

s03.translation: a people that strives to rise.

translation_citations.title: Francis X. Lasance, The Catholic Girl's Guide (1906)

s04.translation: You who, while nature marveled, bore your holy Creator,

translation_citations.title: Francis X. Lasance, The Catholic Girl's Guide (1906)
Francis X. Lasance, The Catholic Girl's Guide (1906)

s06.translation: who received that Ave from the lips of Gabriel, have mercy on sinners.

translation_citations.title: Francis X. Lasance, The Catholic Girl's Guide (1906)

w025.explanation: Mary bears the One who created her: Christ, her own Creator.

w035.explanation: Gabriel's greeting in Lk 1:28, quoted as a word: Mary received “that Ave”. Imperative in form (“hail”), here it names the greeting itself and is the object of “sumens” (w033).
